definitions.explanation: Describes something that is completely new and has never been used.
Describes something that is completely blank or clean with nothing on it.

examples.japanese: まっさらな⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧。
まっさらな⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろした→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
examples.english: I started wearing brand new shoes.

examples.japanese: まっさらな⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: I want to start the new year with a fresh mindset.

examples.japanese: まっさらな⟦{白紙|はくし}→白紙：13626_hakushi⟧。
examples.english: A completely blank sheet of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まっさらな⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my name on a fresh, blank page of the new notebook.

examples.japanese: まっさらな⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to start over from a clean slate.

notes:
FORMS:
- Attributive: まっさらな + noun
- Predicate: まっさらだ
- Also used as a noun: まっさら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun
まっ (emphatic prefix, from {真|ま}) + さら ({更|さら}, new). The prefix intensifies the meaning.

USAGE:
Stronger than ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ (new). Emphasizes the completely pristine, untouched quality.

WATCH OUT:
A mind gone blank from shock or nerves is ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧, not まっさら; まっさらな⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧ is a fresh, unburdened state of mind.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- まっさらな⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧: a fresh mindset
- まっさらな⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a clean slate
- まっさらな⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧: a brand new notebook
